info.title: Ballast API
info.description:
Positions, P&L, fixed income, derivatives, Value-at-Risk, portfolio construction and
performance attribution for the portfolios in a Ballast database.

All endpoints are read-only. Money is in US dollars; returns, volatilities, weights and
rates are decimals (0.05 = 5%) unless a field name ends in `_pct` or `_bp`.
Methodology: https://github.com/AkshayAmbulkar/ballast/tree/main/docs/methodology

get.summary: Bootstrapped Treasury curve (latest, or on a date)
Bond and swap pricing, duration, DV01, key rates and scenarios
Option Greeks and delta-adjusted equity exposure
1-day VaR and Expected Shortfall: historical, parametric and Monte Carlo
Daily VaR backtest with Kupiec, Christoffersen and Basel tests (slow)
Historical market episodes replayed on today's portfolio
Min-variance, max-Sharpe, risk parity, Black-Litterman and frontier
